hardBlockers.description: FAIL when harness validation shows that the stage did not leave the required task state or valid repository state.
FAIL when the shaped task contradicts the feature request, product brief, or confirmed Product Owner decisions.
FAIL when a product decision that materially changes scope or observable behavior remains unresolved while the stage claims completion.
FAIL when the shaped task adds material scope without an explicit requirement or Product Owner decision.
FAIL when the stage wrote or changed application code instead of shaping the task.

requirements.description: The task record states the goal of the work in one clear sentence.
Acceptance criteria are stated as directly observable outcomes: a test that will pass, a command with its expected output, or a screen in a state; never a bare claim that something works.
Every material unknown was surfaced as a product decision with a recommendation, and each resolution is recorded on the task; when nothing needed asking, no questions were manufactured.
The recorded acceptance covers the required success, rejection, and failure behavior of the feature.
The task record names the first test the delivery stage will write.

dimensions.description: How well unknowns are framed as product decisions rather than implementation choices, with sound recommendations.
dimensions.good: B requires each question to be a genuine product decision carrying a defensible recommendation.
dimensions.excellent: A requires questions ordered by architectural consequence, each answerable without reading code, with recommendations grounded in the brief.

dimensions.description: How precisely the acceptance criteria pin observable behavior, including edge and failure paths.
dimensions.good: B requires criteria a fresh session could verify without interpretation.
dimensions.excellent: A requires criteria that also pin boundary and failure behavior so the delivery cannot pass while materially incomplete.

dimensions.description: How tightly the shaped task holds the smallest coherent scope with explicit exclusions.
dimensions.good: B requires no invented scope and a clear boundary around the work.
dimensions.excellent: A requires adjacent behavior that could be inferred to be explicitly included or excluded, with the reasoning recorded.

dimensions.description: How completely the task record alone equips a fresh session to build.
dimensions.good: B requires the record to stand alone without this stage's conversation.
dimensions.excellent: A requires the record to also settle the language, note what is deliberately unplanned, and leave no question a builder would need answered.
